statements: ALTER TABLE ultrabrain.session_receipts ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS deferred boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
ALTER TABLE ultrabrain.session_receipts ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS pending_payload jsonb CHECK (pending_payload IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(pending_payload)='object')
ALTER TABLE ultrabrain.session_receipts ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempts>=0)
ALTER TABLE ultrabrain.session_receipts ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS next_attempt_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
ALTER TABLE ultrabrain.session_receipts DROP CONSTRAINT session_receipts_state_check
ALTER TABLE ultrabrain.session_receipts ADD CONSTRAINT session_receipts_state_check CHECK (state IN ('queued','processing','completed','needs_model','failed'))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS session_deferred_pending_idx ON ultrabrain.session_receipts (source_id,actor,state,next_attempt_at,created_at) WHERE deferred AND pending_payload IS NOT NULL
